You need a simple process that takes you from IDEA ➡️ PRODUCT ➡️ STOREFRONT ➡️ MARKETING. Here are 6 ChatGPT prompts you can copy and paste to help you get started. ⚫ PROMPT 1: FIND A PROFITABLE PRODUCT IDEA “Act as a digital product strategist. Give me 20 beginner-friendly digital product ideas I can create using Canva. Focus on problems people are actively trying to solve. For each idea, identify the target audience, the problem it solves, a suggested selling price, and why someone might purchase it.” ⚫ PROMPT 2: CREATE THE PRODUCT CONTENT “I want to create a [digital product] for [target audience]. Help me develop the complete content, including the title, sections, instructions, worksheets, and any additional information that would make this product useful. Organize everything so I can easily transfer it into Canva.” ⚫ PROMPT 3: DESIGN YOUR PRODUCT IN CANVA “Act as a professional digital product designer. Help me create a design plan for my [digital product]. Recommend a color palette, fonts, page layout, visual elements, and Canva template search terms. Make the design clean, professional, and appealing to my target audience.” ⚫ PROMPT 4: CREATE YOUR SALES PAGE “Act as a conversion copywriter. Write a compelling product description for my [digital product]. Include an attention-grabbing headline, the problem it solves, key benefits, what’s included, and a clear call to action. Make it suitable for a Stan Store product listing.” ⚫ PROMPT 5: ATTRACT POTENTIAL CUSTOMERS “Act as a TikTok content strategist. Create 15 short-form video ideas to promote my [digital product]. Include curiosity-driven hooks, educational captions, and calls to action. Focus on attracting beginners who would benefit from my product without making unrealistic income claims.” ⚫ PROMPT 6: CREATE A 7-DAY MARKETING PLAN “Create a beginner-friendly 7-day marketing plan for launching my [digital product]. Include daily TikTok content ideas, ways to build trust with my audience, engagement strategies, and methods for directing interested viewers to my Stan Store.” ⸻ 💡 HERE’S THE PART MOST BEGINNERS OVERLOOK. Creating a digital product is only half the process. You still need to get people to see it. That’s where digital marketing comes in. You can use ChatGPT to develop the content, Canva to design the product, and Stan Store to sell it. Then use platforms like TikTok to attract people who might actually need what you’ve created. And remember: You don’t need 40 products to get started. You need ONE useful product that solves ONE specific problem for ONE specific audience. Start there. ‼️ Follow me and turn on notifications.
